calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  MIN(f.sale_date) as min_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) as max_sale_date,
  COUNT(*) as sales_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as gross_sales,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as total_refunds,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0))) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as num_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_channel_code,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_channel_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code IS NULL AND channel_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_neither
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  c.channel_name,
  COUNT(*) as num_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, c.channel_name
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, c.channel_name

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as sales_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) as unique_sales_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sales_lines_with_id
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-07-27'
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as sales_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) as unique_sales_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-08-02'

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as return_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) as unique_sales_line_returns,
  SUM(refund_net) as total_refunds
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-08-02'

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as gross_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as refunds,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-08-02'
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0))) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id AND d.fiscal_period = (
  SELECT fiscal_period FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date = r.return_date AND fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
)
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(r.receipts) as num_receipts,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as total_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales) / SUM(r.receipts), 2) as atv
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

-- Store sales from rpt_daily_store_sales
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  'Store' as channel_group,
  SUM(r.receipts) as num_receipts,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as total_net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales) / SUM(r.receipts), 2) as atv
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

-- Web sales (Web home delivery + Click and collect)
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)  -- Web home delivery and Click and collect
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

-- All sales (store + web) with returns adjustment
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as gross_sales,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as total_refunds,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0))) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

-- Aggregate ATV across periods 1-3
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as num_receipts,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0))) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0))) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) as atv_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
